description: This file contains TypeScript classes for performing line-by-line diff operations on text files, including reading streams line-by-line and comparing lines with event emission for differences.

classes.name: StreamLineReader
classes.description: A class for reading a stream line-by-line asynchronously, maintaining current and next line values, line number, and EOF status.

classes.name: TextFileDiff
classes.description: A class extending EventEmitter that performs diff operations between two text files or streams, emitting events for line comparisons and differences.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the StreamLineReader with a readable stream, setting up the async iterator and moving to the first two lines.

methods.name: moveNext
methods.description: Advances the reader to the next line, updating current and next line values, line number, and EOF status.

methods.name: diff
methods.description: Performs a diff between two file paths by creating read streams and comparing their contents line-by-line.

methods.name: diffStream
methods.description: Performs a diff between two readable streams, comparing lines asynchronously and emitting comparison events.

methods.name: compareFn
methods.description: Compares two lines lexicographically, returning 1, -1, or 0.

methods.name: doCompareLineReader
methods.description: Compares current lines from two StreamLineReaders, emits events for differences, and advances the readers accordingly.
